title: Create your first alert rule: query

blocks.content:
Welcome to the alert rule query learning path. You'll navigate to the alert rule page, name your rule, select a data source, and build a query that returns the data you want to monitor.

This is the first step of creating a complete Grafana-managed alert rule. Each learning path in this series covers one section of the alert rule GUI.

## Here's what to expect

When you complete this path, you'll be able to:

- Navigate to the alert rule creation page in Grafana
- Give your rule a descriptive name
- Select a data source and build a query
- Preview query results to verify your data selection

## Before you begin

Before you start, ensure you have:

- A Grafana Cloud account. To create one, refer to [Grafana Cloud](https://grafana.com/signup/cloud/connect-account).
- The TestData data source is available in every Grafana instance (no setup required).

## Troubleshooting

If you get stuck, we've got your back! Where appropriate, troubleshooting information is just a click away.
